revisions.text: The team is depending on you, Viscous, and you won't let them down.
You wonder why you were made, what your purpose is. Let me help you find answers.
You are wise to see the danger the adversary poses. Summon me and let me protect the denizens of the deep.
You are wise to see the danger The Adversary poses.  Summon The Hidden King, so that he may protect the denizens of The Deep.
